title: Two-dimensional galaxy cluster shapes using lensing data: a simulated analysis
comment: submitted to A&A, 16 pages, 9 figures; comments are welcome
summary: Context. Cluster morphology reflects assembly history and dynamical state. High-resolution weak lensing can reveal departures from spherical symmetry, but its ability to recover two-dimensional shapes remains less explored. Aims. We assess how reliably weak lensing recovers projected cluster morphology and its dependence on orientation and dynamical state. We also compare large-scale weak-lensing morphology with that traced by strong lensing near the cluster centre. Methods. We study three clusters at $z=0.22$ from The Three Hundred Project, representing relaxed, mildly disturbed and unrelaxed systems. For each, we consider three random projections and three along the principal axes of the mass tensor. For each projection, we generate 128 weak-lensing catalogues with a source density of 30 arcmin$^{-2}$ and intrinsic ellipticity dispersion $σ_ε=0.3$. We constrain mass and concentration from one-dimensional NFW and BMO fits, then recover ellipticity, position angle and centre using a two-dimensional elliptical NFW model. We also measure morphology from true convergence maps, Kaiser \& Squires reconstructions and strong-lensing tangential critical lines. Results. Recovered parameters depend on orientation and dynamical state. The relaxed cluster has similar inner and large-scale shapes, whereas disturbed systems appear more elliptical centrally. Two-dimensional weak-lensing modelling recovers the projected mass orientation despite source sampling and shape noise. Kaiser \& Squires reconstructions recover the position angle well but favour rounder mass distributions. Centroid offsets are larger in unrelaxed systems. Conclusions. Combining weak- and strong-lensing morphology probes cluster structure across physical scales and offers a promising way to investigate morphology and dynamical state.

artifacts.abstract_zh: 背景。星系团形态反映了其组装历史和动力学状态。高分辨率弱引力透镜可以揭示偏离球对称的结构，但其恢复二维形状的能力仍较少被探索。目标。我们评估弱引力透镜恢复投影星系团形态的可靠性及其对取向和动力学状态的依赖。我们还比较了大尺度弱引力透镜形态与星系团中心附近强引力透镜所描绘的形态。方法。我们研究来自The Three Hundred Project的$z=0.22$处的三个星系团，分别代表弛豫、轻度扰动和未弛豫系统。对于每个星系团，我们考虑三个随机投影和沿质量张量主轴的三个投影。对于每个投影，我们生成128个弱引力透镜星表，源密度为30 arcmin$^{-2}$，内禀椭率弥散$σ_ε=0.3$。我们通过一维NFW和BMO拟合约束质量和浓度，然后使用二维椭圆NFW模型恢复椭率、位置角和中心。我们还从真实收敛图、Kaiser \& Squires重建和强引力透镜切向临界线测量形态。结果。恢复的参数取决于取向和动力学状态。弛豫星系团的内侧和大尺度形状相似，而扰动系统在中心显得更椭圆。尽管存在源采样和形状噪声，二维弱引力透镜建模仍能恢复投影质量取向。Kaiser \& Squires重建能很好地恢复位置角，但倾向于更圆的质量分布。未弛豫系统中的质心偏移更大。结论。结合弱引力透镜和强引力透镜形态可在不同物理尺度上探测星系团结构，为研究形态和动力学状态提供了一种有前景的方法。

title: Neglecting Dynamical Microlensing Can Bias Accretion Disk Size Measurements at the Population Level
summary: Microlensing of strongly lensed quasars probes unresolved accretion disks, but many inference methods use static magnification maps with fixed relative microlens positions. Using the GPU-accelerated simulator Microcaustics, we generate ten-year multiband light curves for three quadruply lensed quasar configurations. We compare dynamical microlensing with independent microlens motions against coherent bulk motion, and a microlens mass distribution against equal masses, keeping the velocity distribution of individual microlenses and mean mass fixed. We infer population disk sizes using ridge regression on the means and lower and upper scatters of ten variability and event metrics. We measure biases by applying models trained with simplified physics to simulations including both effects. Models trained on coherent motion interpret the additional variability from evolving caustics as smaller disks. For populations of 128 independent realizations, jointly inferred radii are consistently smaller by 6-28%. Microlens dynamics increase caustic-crossing rates pooled across all four macroimages by 5-15% and r-band high-magnification-event (HME) rates by 13-25%, while shortening median HME durations by 4-12%. Omitting the mass distribution produces configuration-dependent disk-size offsets from -12% to +5%. Including the mass distribution decreases caustic-crossing rates by 6-8% and HME rates by 6-12%. It also narrows the spread of ten-year averaged microlensing time-delay differences between macroimages by a median of 9-12% per system, while microlens dynamics have a smaller, image-pair-dependent effect. These results demonstrate the importance of microlens dynamics for population disk-size inference and motivate simulations that include dynamical microlensing and a microlens mass distribution.

AI.tldr: 基于GPU加速模拟器Microcaustics生成三个四重透镜类星体的十年多波段光变曲线，系统比较动态微引力透镜效应（独立微引力透镜运动 vs. 相干整体运动）与微引力透镜质量分布对吸积盘尺寸推断及焦散统计的影响，揭示简化物理模型带来的系统性偏差。
AI.motivation: 强透镜类星体的微引力透镜可探测未分辨的吸积盘，但许多推断方法使用静态放大率图并固定微引力透镜相对位置，忽略了微引力透镜运动和微引力透镜质量分布等真实物理效应，可能造成盘尺寸估计的系统偏差，需量化这些偏差。
AI.method: 使用GPU加速的Microcaustics模拟器，为三个四重透镜类星体构型生成十年多波段光变曲线；对比动态微引力透镜（独立运动）与相干整体运动，以及在保持单个微引力透镜速度分布和平均质量不变时，质量分布与等质量情形。对十项变异性与事件指标的均值及上下散射用岭回归推断群体盘尺寸，并用仅含简化物理训练的模型去拟合同时包含两种效应的模拟，测量偏差。
AI.result: 在相干运动上训练的模型将演化焦散带来的额外变异性误读为更小的盘：128个独立实现的群体联合推断半径系统性偏小6–28%。微引力透镜动力学使四个宏像汇总的焦散穿越率提高5–15%，r波段高放大事件（HME）率提高13–25%，同时使HME中位持续时间缩短4–12%。忽略质量分布导致盘尺寸偏移随构型在−12%至+5%之间。纳入质量分布使焦散穿越率下降6–8%、HME率下降6–12%，并使宏像间十年平均微引力透镜时延差的离散度中位数收窄9–12%，而微引力透镜动力学的影响较小且依赖像对。
AI.conclusion: 微引力透镜动力学对群体盘尺寸推断具有重要影响，简化物理会引入显著系统偏差；未来模拟应同时包含动态微引力透镜与微引力透镜质量分布，以保证盘尺寸推断的可靠性。

title: Measuring the magnetization profiles of galaxy groups and clusters
summary: Magnetic fields are vital in determining the physical conditions of baryons in massive halos. They are, however, notoriously difficult to observe. This impacts problems from our understanding of galaxy formation, to the observed deficit in the amplitude of thermal Sunyaev-Zel'dovich (tSZ) power spectrum that affects cosmological inferences. Although Faraday rotation measures (RMs) offer a direct probe of magnetic fields, it weights magnetic fields by the free-electron density. Several probes of free electrons, including fast radio burst (FRB) dispersion measures (DMs) and kinematic SZ (kSZ) effect, are now maturing into precision tools. We combine RM$^2$ stacks from SPICE-RACS around DESI galaxy groups and ROSAT clusters with optical depth profiles constrained jointly by the FRB DM-redshift relation and the kSZ effect, and obtain 95% upper limits on the rms line-of-sight magnetic field of $<3.9$-$11.6~μ$G ($<2.3$-$6.4~μ$G) in groups (clusters) for a 10~kpc coherence length. Combining these with thermal pressure profiles inferred from tSZ-shear cross-correlations, we obtain 95% lower limits on the plasma $β$ of $>0.31$ ($>11$) in groups (clusters). Although current constraints are only limits, we forecast a first detection with larger datasets from the Deep Synoptic Array (DSA). We present the first forecast of the DSA RM grid density ($\sim365$ RMs deg$^{-2}$), which when combined with 10$^4$ FRBs would measure the field in groups to $3$-$13\%$ precision, compared to current constraints of $38$-$75\%$. Although the interpretation of current measurements remains challenging owing to depolarization along turbulent halo sightlines and the unknown coherence length, larger samples and DSA/Square Kilometer Array observations may resolve these uncertainties by measuring polarization-fraction profiles and the RM structure function using extended radio sources, respectively.

title: Towards Reliably Measuring the Mass-Size Relation of Dark Matter Halos: Impact of projection, miscentering and Eddington bias
comment: 25 pages, 18 figures. Comments and feedback welcome
summary: In the conventional spherical overdensity definition of a dark matter halo, masses and radii, e.g. $M_{200{\rm m}}$ and $r_{200{\rm m}}$, are equivalent. However, halos do exhibit a physical boundary at the splashback radius $r_{\rm sp}$, which manifests as a sharp drop in density. Splashback radii are now routinely measured in stacked weak lensing profiles, but the expected trend of decreasing $r_{\rm sp}/r_{200{\rm m}}$ with mass has not been verified in observed galaxy groups or clusters. In this work, we show that several observational effects conceal the predicted mass-size relation. In particular, we quantify the impact of systematics on the mean density and lensing profiles of mock-observed halo samples, which are created by applying a realistic cluster-finding procedure to dark matter-only simulations. We reproduce the known impact of projection: preferentially observing systems in overdense regions. But, differing from previous works, we show that the same projection effect, combined with scatter in observed luminosities, causes a significant Eddington bias in the derived mass-observable relation and a complex suppression in mean density profiles over all radial scales. The magnitude of this effect is mass-dependent and coupled to the cluster-finding procedure and survey properties, making it challenging to model simply and motivating full forward-modeling of observed group and cluster samples. However, we demonstrate that a simple mitigation approach, effectively a weak lensing mass calibration, does well in approximately recovering the true mass-size relation. Finally, we show that only severe miscentering can bias the measurement of the halo size, but any miscentering can increase the measurement uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 该文通过将真实的星系团寻找流程应用于暗物质-only模拟构建"模拟观测"晕样本，系统量化了投影效应、光度散布导致的Eddington偏置等观测系统误差对晕平均密度剖面及溅回半径-质量关系的影响，并指出弱引力透镜质量定标可近似恢复真实质量-尺度关系。

AI.method: 对暗物质-only模拟施加贴近真实的星系团寻找流程，生成mock-observed晕样本；量化各类系统误差对平均密度剖面与透镜剖面（lensing profiles）的影响，重点分析投影效应与观测光度散布共同作用下的Eddington偏置及质量-可观测量关系的偏差；并检验弱引力透镜质量定标这一缓解手段及中心定位误差（miscentering）的影响。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 在暗物质晕传统的球状过密度定义中，质量和半径（例如 $M_{200{\rm m}}$ 和 $r_{200{\rm m}}$）是等价的。然而，暗晕在回溅半径 $r_{\rm sp}$ 处确实表现出物理边界，表现为密度的急剧下降。回溅半径现在已常规地在堆叠弱引力透镜剖面中测量，但预期的 $r_{\rm sp}/r_{200{\rm m}}$ 随质量下降的趋势尚未在观测到的星系群或星系团中得到验证。在这项工作中，我们表明若干观测效应掩盖了预测的质量-尺度关系。特别地，我们量化了系统误差对模拟观测暗晕样本的平均密度和透镜剖面的影响，这些样本是通过将现实的星系团查找程序应用于纯暗物质模拟而创建的。我们再现了投影的已知影响：优先观测处于过密区域的系统。但是，与之前的工作不同，我们表明相同的投影效应，结合观测光度的散布，在推导的质量-可观测量关系中引起显著的Eddington偏置，并在所有径向尺度上对平均密度剖面产生复杂的抑制。这种效应的幅度依赖于质量，并与星系团查找程序和巡天性质耦合，使其难以简单建模，并促使对观测到的星系群和星系团样本进行完整的正向建模。然而，我们证明一种简单的缓解方法，实际上是一种弱引力透镜质量定标，在近似恢复真实质量-尺度关系方面表现良好。最后，我们表明只有严重的中心错位才能偏置暗晕尺度的测量，但任何中心错位都会增加测量不确定性。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于可用摘要：观测到的 $r_{\rm sp}/r_{200{\rm m}}$ 与质量的关系被多种观测效应（尤其是投影加Eddington偏置）所掩盖，需要对观测到的星系群/星系团样本进行完整的正向建模；一种简单的缓解方法——等效于弱引力透镜质量定标——可以近似恢复真实的质量-尺度关系。

title: How common are extreme scattering events?: First large sample from the ASKAP VAST survey
comment: Under review in The Astrophysical Journal, any comments are welcome
summary: Compact radio sources are occasionally observed to undergo extreme scattering events (ESEs): large, chromatic flux-density variations, often by more than a factor of two, over a few months. These were interpreted to be a smooth plasma lensing phenomenon due to AU-scale structures in the ISM. Although ESEs were discovered decades ago, observationally, only a few tens of ESEs have been reported, often from individual sources monitored at very high cadences. As such, the nature of the plasma lenses generating such events remains elusive. In this article, we present the most comprehensive sample of ESEs to date, using the ASKAP Variables and Slow Transients (VAST) survey. We report the discovery of a three-tier sample --- 72 sources that show promising ESE events (gold), 76 sources that are likely ESE-exhibiting (silver), and an additional 88 sources where ESE events are one plausible explanation (bronze). We show that the light curves demonstrate varied morphologies, which can be interpreted in terms of the source size and the strength of the lens in the paradigm of a simple one-dimensional Gaussian lens model. The spatial distribution of ESEs shows an appreciable excess in the direction of the Galactic center and along the Galactic loops. Using this sample, we infer an overall rate of 0.012 such events per year per deg^2 (or 0.006 events per source per year) for our (gold+silver) sample, for sources with mean flux density above 5 mJy at 888 MHz (0.01% of all isolated point sources detected in VAST).

AI.tldr: 利用ASKAP VAST巡天构建迄今最全面的极端散射事件(ESE)样本，按置信度分为金(72)、银(76)、铜(88)三级共236个源，并用简单一维高斯等离子体透镜模型解释光变形态，估算了发生率与空间分布。
AI.motivation: ESE（致密射电源在数月内出现大幅色散型流量变化）虽发现数十年，但观测样本仅数十个、多来自个别源的高频监测，因而产生ESE的等离子体透镜本质仍不清楚，亟需大样本统计研究。
AI.method: 使用ASKAP的Variables and Slow Transients (VAST)巡天数据，系统搜寻ESE并分级为金/银/铜三档样本；用简单一维高斯透镜模型拟合光变曲线形态，结合源尺寸与透镜强度进行解释；统计空间分布并计算事件发生率。
AI.result: 发现236个ESE候选（金72、银76、铜88）；光变曲线形态多样，可用源尺寸与透镜强度在一维高斯透镜框架下解释；ESE在银心方向及银河系环带方向明显聚集；金+银样本中888 MHz平均流量>5 mJy源的ESE发生率为每平方度每年0.012次（每源每年0.006次），仅占VAST探测到的孤立点源的0.01%。
AI.conclusion: VAST提供了迄今最大、分级明确的ESE样本，支持ESE由星际介质中AU尺度结构引起的平滑等离子体透镜解释，并为透镜性质、空间分布与发生率提供统计约束。

artifacts.abstract_zh: 紧凑射电源偶尔会被观测到经历极端散射事件（ESEs）：在几个月内出现大幅度的、随频率变化的流量密度变化，通常超过两倍。这些现象被解释为由星际介质中AU尺度结构引起的平滑等离子体透镜现象。尽管ESEs在几十年前就已被发现，但在观测上，仅报告了几十个ESEs，且通常来自以极高采样率监测的单个源。因此，产生此类事件的等离子体透镜的性质仍然难以捉摸。在本文中，我们利用ASKAP变源与慢暂现源（VAST）巡天，呈现了迄今为止最全面的ESE样本。我们报告发现了一个三级样本——72个显示有希望ESE事件的源（金级）、76个可能表现出ESE的源（银级），以及另外88个ESE事件是其中一种合理解释的源（铜级）。我们表明，光变曲线呈现出多种形态，这可以在简单一维高斯透镜模型的范式下，根据源尺寸和透镜强度来解释。ESEs的空间分布在银河系中心方向和沿银河系环方向显示出明显的超出。利用该样本，我们推断出（金+银）样本在888 MHz下平均流量密度高于5 mJy的源中，此类事件的总体发生率为每年每deg^2 0.012次（或每个源每年0.006次）（占VAST探测到的所有孤立点源的0.01%）。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于现有摘要：VAST提供了迄今最大、分级明确的ESE样本，支持ESE由星际介质中AU尺度结构引起的平滑等离子体透镜解释，并为透镜性质、空间分布与发生率提供统计约束。

title: Galactic Dynamics Drives Cyclic Star Formation in Dipole Dwarf Galaxies
summary: Dwarf galaxies are dark matter-dominated systems that are sensitive to feedback and display bursty star formation histories. This makes them ideal probes of the processes that regulate star formation. This work investigates the timescales of star formation rate (SFR) variability in isolated dwarf galaxies using high-resolution cosmological zoom-in simulations of $50$ dwarf galaxies drawn from the Marvelous Massive Dwarfs and Extended Marvelous Dwarfs simulation suites ($7.3 <$ \lmstar $< 9.1$). We measure star formation histories in $10$ Myr bins and characterize their variability with power spectral densities (PSDs). At the population level, the PSDs of both disk and non-disk galaxies follow a broken power-law, with a break timescale near $100$ Myr. Individually, our galaxies show both smooth and bursty star formation. A subset of disk galaxies show quasi-periodic SFR oscillations about their mean, which we refer to as cyclic star formation. The dominant timescale of these oscillations scales linearly with half-light radius and is approximated by the orbital period at that radius. Cyclic galaxies have Magellanic Spiral (Sm) morphologies and host lopsided dipole gas disks. In these systems, the bulk of the gas in the lopsided disk moves between its maximum and minimum distance from the galactic center, compressing the star-forming gas once per radial orbit and driving the SFR cycle. Cyclic star formation adds a narrow Lorentzian component to the PSD, peaked at radial orbital frequency of the disk ($\sim 200-500$ Myr), which is comparable to burst timescales inferred from observations.

figures.caption_en: Figure 1: Welch power spectral density of \(\log\,{SFR}_{10}\) as a function of fluctuation timescale \(\tau_{k}\) (bottom axis) and frequency \(f_{k}\) (top axis) for disk (left) and non-disk (right) galaxies. Gray lines show the \({PSD}_{Welch}\) of individual galaxies. Solid lines show the mean of each subsample (for \(\tau_{k}\leq 1\) Gyr) and shaded bands show the \(1\sigma\) scatter. Red dashed lines show broken power-law fits to the mean \({PSD}_{Welch}\) and \(1\sigma\) scatter, with the high-frequency slope \(\beta_{high}\) , break timescale \(\tau_{b}\) , and break amplitude \(S_{b}\) listed in each panel. SFHs are constructed in \(\Delta t=10\) Myr bins from the formation time of all star particles residing in each galaxy at \(z=0\) . The two subsamples show broadly similar distributions, with a characteristic broken power-law that resembles a damped random walk ( \(\beta_{low}=0,\ \beta_{high}=2\) ).

figures.caption_en: Figure 2: Comparison of a cyclic (green, disk galaxy), bursty (black, non-disk galaxy), and smooth (orange, disk galaxy) SFH over the last \(4\) Gyr prior to \(z=0\) ( \(\Delta t=10\,{Myr}\) bins). Left: \(\log\,{SFR}\) after subtracting a 1 Gyr boxcar moving mean. Right: FFT amplitude spectrum of the moving mean subtracted SFH as a function of fluctuation timescale. The cyclic galaxy exhibits a sharply peaked spectrum dominated by a single mode, indicating quasi-periodic SFR oscillations at a well-defined timescale. In the second row, though the bursty galaxy spans a wider mean subtracted SFR distribution, it lacks a dominating timescale that imprints structure into the SFH (stochastic and aperiodic variability). The smooth SFH in the bottom panels also shows stochastic and aperiodic variability, but lacks strong variability (low amplitudes across its frequency spectrum).
figures.caption_zh: 图2：在\(z=0\)之前的最后\(4\) Gyr内（\(\Delta t=10\,{Myr}\)区间），循环（绿色，盘星系）、爆发（黑色，非盘星系）和平滑（橙色，盘星系）SFH的比较。左：减去1 Gyr箱车移动平均后的\(\log\,{SFR}\)。右：移动平均减去后的SFH的FFT振幅谱随涨落时间尺度的变化。循环星系表现出一个由单一模式主导的尖锐峰值谱，表明在明确的时间尺度上存在准周期性的SFR振荡。在第二行中，尽管爆发星系跨越了更宽的移动平均减去后的SFR分布，但它缺乏一个主导时间尺度来在SFH中留下结构（随机和非周期性变率）。底部面板中的平滑SFH也显示出随机和非周期性变率，但缺乏强变率（其频谱中振幅较低）。

figures.caption_en: Figure 3: Normalized \({PSD}_{Welch}\) of the raw SFHs of all galaxies in our final sample during the last \(4\) Gyr leading up to \(z=0\) , split into three bins of \(\zeta_{SFR}\) (top to bottom, \(0.00\) – \(0.20\) , \(0.20\) – \(0.50\) , and \(0.5\) – \(1.0\) ). With increasing \(\zeta_{SFR}\) , the frequencies of cyclic SFH against the mean appear as larger bumps in the raw \({PSD}_{Welch}\) .
figures.caption_zh: 图3：最终样本中所有星系在\(z=0\)之前的最后\(4\) Gyr内原始SFH的归一化\({PSD}_{Welch}\)，按\(\zeta_{SFR}\)分为三个区间（从上到下，\(0.00\) – \(0.20\)、\(0.20\) – \(0.50\)和\(0.5\) – \(1.0\)）。橙线显示盘星系，黑线显示非盘星系。\(\tau_{peak}\)是在\(\tau_{k}\leq 1\) Gyr处PSD功率峰值的时间尺度，而\(\zeta_{SFR}\)是从均值减去后的SFH的振幅谱中测量的。随着\(\zeta_{SFR}\)的增加，相对于均值的循环SFH频率在原始\({PSD}_{Welch}\)中表现为更大的隆起。

title: A Collimated Protostellar Outflow Likely Driven by Jet and Reshaped by Environment in the Sagittarius C Cloud of the Central Molecular Zone
summary: The Central Molecular Zone (CMZ) at the center of the Galaxy provides a nearby laboratory for studying star formation under extreme physical and chemical conditions. Recent ALMA (Atacama Large Millimeter/Submillimeter Array) observations have identified 43 candidate protostellar outflows in three CMZ clouds. One of these, the Sgr C-F#2 outflow in Sagittarius C (Sgr C), has a highly collimated lobe extending approximately 0.8 pc in projection. Here we present a joint analysis of ALMA observations of SiO J=8-7, 5-4, and 2-1. We use local thermodynamic equilibrium (LTE) and non-LTE methods to constrain the SiO column densities, H2 number density, and gas temperature. The low SiO rotational temperatures and higher kinetic temperatures inferred from non-LTE methods suggest subthermal excitation. The elongated SiO morphology, shock-excited gas, position-velocity structure, and the alignment of the red shifted molecular lobe with JWST infrared knots altogether favor jet-dominated entrainment, whereas a broader disk-wind component close to the source cannot be excluded. The outflow shows asymmetries in its morphology and physical properties, which can be attributed to dense gas on the path of its lobe impeding its propagation and feedback from a nearby HII region imposing different pressure on its two sides.

title: Unveiling the nonthermal environments of NGC 3411 and NGC 5903 through new MeerKAT observations
summary: Galaxy groups are key laboratories for investigating the interplay between active galactic nucleus (AGN) outbursts and the dynamical processes of the intra-group medium. We aim to characterize the morphology, spectral properties, and magnetic field structure of the diffuse nonthermal radio emission in two peculiar galaxy groups, NGC 3411 and NGC 5903, selected from an originally larger sample, in order to constrain its origin and its connection with the dynamics of the intra-group medium. We present new MeerKAT UHF- and L-band observations of the two groups, complemented by archival Chandra and XMM-Newton data already analyzed in previous works. In NGC 3411, we detect extended radio emission surrounding the central AGN over scales of ~70 kpc, and resolve previously undetected arc-shaped substructures on scales of ~20-30 kpc. This extended component exhibits a relatively uniform steep spectrum ($α$ ~ -1.7). We discuss possible scenarios for its origin, including mini-halos, aged AGN plasma, weak shocks, and the possibility of a radio galaxy observed along the line of sight. In NGC 5903, MeerKAT reveals a complex filamentary morphology, including a previously unknown ring-like structure surrounding the central AGN. Spectral-index mapping shows localized flattening ($α$ ~ -0.9) along the north arc, while polarization data reveal ordered magnetic fields and a patchy rotation measure distribution across the source. Together with the disturbed X-ray morphology, these results support a scenario in which fossil AGN plasma has been redistributed and locally reenergized by group-scale dynamical processes such as turbulence, shear, and weak compression. Our results demonstrate that galaxy groups can host a rich variety of nonthermal phenomena, whose properties can only be fully revealed through the combination of sensitive, high-resolution, and multifrequency radio observations.

artifacts.abstract_zh: 星系群是研究活动星系核（AGN）爆发与星系群内介质动力学过程之间相互作用的关键实验室。我们旨在表征两个特殊星系群NGC 3411和NGC 5903中弥漫非热射电辐射的形态、光谱性质和磁场结构，这两个星系群选自一个原本更大的样本，以约束其起源及其与星系群内介质动力学的联系。我们呈现了这两个星系群的新MeerKAT UHF和L波段观测，并辅以先前工作中已分析过的 archival Chandra 和 XMM-Newton 数据。在NGC 3411中，我们探测到围绕中心AGN的延伸射电辐射，尺度约为70 kpc，并分辨出先前未探测到的弧状子结构，尺度约为20-30 kpc。该延伸成分表现出相对均匀的陡谱（$\alpha$ ~ -1.7）。我们讨论了其起源的可能情景，包括迷你晕、老化的AGN等离子体、弱激波，以及沿视线方向观测到的射电星系的可能性。在NGC 5903中，MeerKAT揭示出复杂的纤维状形态，包括围绕中心AGN的先前未知的环状结构。谱指数映射显示沿北弧的局部平坦化（$\alpha$ ~ -0.9），而偏振数据揭示出有序磁场和源内斑块状的旋转测度分布。结合扰动的X射线形态，这些结果支持一种情景：化石AGN等离子体已被星系群尺度的动力学过程（如湍流、剪切和弱压缩）重新分布并局部再加速。我们的结果表明，星系群可以承载丰富多样的非热现象，其性质只有通过结合灵敏、高分辨率和多频射电观测才能完全揭示。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于现有摘要：两个星系群中的结果支持化石AGN等离子体被星系群尺度动力学过程（如湍流、剪切和弱压缩）重新分布并局部再加速的情形。星系群可承载丰富多样的非热现象，只有结合灵敏、高分辨率、多频射电观测才能完整揭示其性质。

figures.caption_en: Figure 1: Left : Optical image from the DESI Legacy survey of NGC 3411, with overlaid radio emission (red is fainter, yellow is brighter) as detected with our new UHF-band observation from MeerKAT. Right : Optical image from the DESI Legacy survey of NGC 5903, with overlaid radio emission as detected with our new L-band observation from MeerKAT.
figures.caption_zh: 图1：左：来自DESI Legacy巡天的NGC 3411光学图像，叠加了我们的MeerKAT新UHF波段观测探测到的射电辐射（红色较暗，黄色较亮）。右：来自DESI Legacy巡天的NGC 5903光学图像，叠加了我们的MeerKAT新L波段观测探测到的射电辐射。

figures.caption_en: Figure 2: Left : UHF-band MeerKAT image of NGC 3411 produced with Briggs -0.3 . The rms noise is \(\sim\) 19 \(\mu\) Jy beam -1 , and the beam (shown in the bottom left) is \(10^{\prime\prime}\times 8^{\prime\prime}\) . Right : L-band MeerKAT image of NGC 3411 produced with Briggs -0.3 . The rms noise is \(\sim\) 18 \(\mu\) Jy beam -1 , and the beam (shown in the bottom left) is \(7^{\prime\prime}\times 5^{\prime\prime}\) .
figures.caption_zh: 图2：左：使用Briggs -0.3生成的NGC 3411 UHF波段MeerKAT图像。均方根噪声约为\(\sim\) 19 \(\mu\) Jy beam -1，波束（显示在左下角）为\(10^{\prime\prime}\times 8^{\prime\prime}\)。右：使用Briggs -0.3生成的NGC 3411 L波段MeerKAT图像。均方根噪声约为\(\sim\) 18 \(\mu\) Jy beam -1，波束（显示在左下角）为\(7^{\prime\prime}\times 5^{\prime\prime}\)。

figures.caption_en: Figure 3: Left : Spectral index map of NGC 3411 between the MeerKAT UHF and L bands. L-band contours are shown in black. Right : Spectral index error map of NGC 3411. Both maps are produced at resolution \(10^{\prime\prime}\times 8^{\prime\prime}\) , and the beam is shown on the bottom left.
figures.caption_zh: 图3：左：NGC 3411在MeerKAT UHF和L波段之间的谱指数图。L波段等值线以黑色显示。右：NGC 3411的谱指数误差图。两幅图均在分辨率\(10^{\prime\prime}\times 8^{\prime\prime}\)下生成，波束显示在左下角。

figures.caption_en: Figure 4: Left : UHF-band MeerKAT image of NGC 5903 produced with Briggs -0.3 . The rms noise is \(\sim\) 38 \(\mu\) Jy beam -1 , and the beam (shown in the bottom left) is \(10^{\prime\prime}\times 8^{\prime\prime}\) . Right : L-band MeerKAT image of NGC 5903 produced with Briggs -0.3 . The rms noise is \(\sim\) 19 \(\mu\) Jy beam -1 , and the beam (shown in the bottom left) is \(6^{\prime\prime}\times 5^{\prime\prime}\) .
figures.caption_zh: 图4：左：使用Briggs -0.3生成的NGC 5903 UHF波段MeerKAT图像。均方根噪声约为\(\sim\) 38 \(\mu\) Jy beam -1，波束（显示在左下角）为\(10^{\prime\prime}\times 8^{\prime\prime}\)。右：使用Briggs -0.3生成的NGC 5903 L波段MeerKAT图像。均方根噪声约为\(\sim\) 19 \(\mu\) Jy beam -1，波束（显示在左下角）为\(6^{\prime\prime}\times 5^{\prime\prime}\)。

figures.caption_en: Figure 5: Spectral index map of NGC 5903 between the MeerKAT UHF and L bands. L-band contours are shown in black.
figures.caption_zh: 图5：NGC 5903在MeerKAT UHF和L波段之间的谱指数图。L波段等值线以黑色显示。

figures.caption_en: Figure 6: Polarization maps in the L band of NGC 5903. Left : Polarization intensity map (corrected for Ricean bias) with magnetic field vectors (corrected for Faraday rotation) overlaid in black. Total intensity contours are shown in white. Right : Polarization fraction map, clipped at 6 \(\sigma\) , with total intensity contours overlaid in black.
figures.caption_zh: 图6：NGC 5903的L波段偏振图。左：偏振强度图（已校正Ricean偏差），叠加了黑色磁场矢量（已校正法拉第旋转）。总强度等值线以白色显示。右：偏振度图，在6 \(\sigma\)处截断，叠加了黑色总强度等值线。

figures.caption_en: Figure 7: Left : 0.3–2 keV XMM-Newton exposure-corrected map of NGC 3411, adapted from OS07. L-band contours are overlaid in white. Right : Two-dimensional temperature map of NGC 3411, with L-band contours, adapted from OS07, overlaid.
figures.caption_zh: 图7：左：NGC 3411的0.3–2 keV XMM-Newton曝光校正图，改编自OS07。L波段等值线以白色叠加。右：NGC 3411的二维温度图，叠加了改编自OS07的L波段等值线。

figures.caption_en: Figure 8: Left : Regions from where the surface brightness in the radio and X-ray bands has been sampled for the point-to-point analysis of NGC 3411. Each region is as large as the XMM-Newton resolution ( \(15^{\prime\prime}\) ). Center : Results of the point-to-point analysis. No correlation is found between the radio (x-axis) and the X-ray (y-axis) surface brightness, with a Spearman coefficient of \(p\sim 0.45\) . Right : Mini-halo radio power at 1.4 GHz vs. cluster mass for the galaxy cluster sample studied in Ubertosi et al. (under review). The data point for NGC 3411 is shown in orange. The dashed line shows the best fit from Ubertosi et al. (under review), while the gray region represents the \(68\%\) confidence band.
figures.caption_zh: 图8：左：用于NGC 3411逐点分析的射电和X射线波段表面亮度采样区域。每个区域与XMM-Newton分辨率（\(15^{\prime\prime}\)）一样大。中：逐点分析结果。射电（x轴）和X射线（y轴）表面亮度之间未发现相关性，Spearman系数为\(p\sim 0.45\)。右：Ubertosi等人（审稿中）研究的星系团样本中1.4 GHz处迷你晕射电功率与星系团质量的关系。NGC 3411的数据点以橙色显示。虚线显示Ubertosi等人（审稿中）的最佳拟合，灰色区域代表\(68\%\)置信带。
